candidate_title: EON Cusp: a receipt can close a claim, not turn it into truth
one_sentence_story: A source fragment becomes an ordered evidence stream, passes through a transparent Context Capsule and a torus-shaped cusp, then closes as an explicitly labelled S6 paper claim beside a world trace and receipt.

beats.name: source-fragment
beats.causal_move: A single source artifact is isolated from the dark terrain.
beats.visual: On the left, one warm paper card rises from a low hexagonal plinth; all text is replaced by three clean ruled lines and one legible label: SOURCE.
beats.motion: The card lifts 12 px and emits one amber point; no other object moves.
beats.caption: Start with the source, not the verdict.
beats.receipt_role: The artifact is an input pointer, not evidence supplied by the image reference.
beats.source_receipt: shared prompt source_boundary; concept-01-evidence-thread.png is visual grammar only

beats.name: one-stream-order
beats.causal_move: The source emits one ordered stream instead of branching into dashboard noise.
beats.visual: The amber point travels along one Bezier ribbon toward center. Five evenly spaced pulses carry ordinal positions 01, 02, 03, 04, 05 as large readable marks.
beats.motion: Only the next pulse brightens as it advances; previous pulses dim but remain on the same path.
beats.caption: Order is a sequence of events, not a wall clock.
beats.receipt_role: The visualizes the Section 6 distinction between ordinal sequence and global calendar time.

beats.name: context-capsule
beats.causal_move: The stream is constrained by context before it is allowed to become a claim.
beats.visual: A transparent glass capsule appears around the stream. Inside it, one crisp line reads EVENT-ORDERED; beneath it a smaller line reads NOT WALL-CLOCK.
beats.motion: The capsule closes with four vertical edges; the stream continues through it without changing path.
beats.caption: Context narrows what the stream is allowed to mean.
beats.receipt_role: The capsule is a visual reasoning boundary, not a measured operational component.

beats.name: torus-cusp-test
beats.causal_move: The constrained stream passes one falsifier gate before closure.
beats.visual: Three nested torus rings rotate slowly around the stream. A single hexagonal cusp fibre crosses the innermost ring and displays the readable test label COUNTER ON EON. A thin rejected branch falls dark beneath the ring and is labelled WALL-CLOCK.
beats.motion: The cusp fibre turns 60 degrees; the accepted stream stays luminous, while the rejected branch fades to zero.
beats.caption: A claim stays alive only while its disqualifying observation is visible.
beats.receipt_role: The test is derived from the falsifier requirement and from EON as the remaining-edge counter surface; the render does not create a live measurement.

beats.name: claim-receipt-world-trace
beats.causal_move: The surviving stream is sealed as a paper claim beside its receipt and world trace.
beats.visual: On the right, a cool paper receipt and a small traversable hex-world node appear. The final plate reads PAPER CLAIM (S6), then EON PLACES THE REMAINING-EDGE COUNTER ON AN ORDINAL/EVENT SURFACE. A final footer reads CLAIM, NOT CONSENSUS FACT.
beats.motion: The torus stops, the receipt receives one cyan tick, and the world node lights only after the claim plate is visible.
beats.caption: Closed on the page; still open to falsification in the world.
beats.receipt_role: The receipt records the source path and claim boundary; it does not certify truth.

timeline.action: Create source_card and its plinth; FadeIn source_card; emit one amber Dot.
Create one CubicBezier path; move five fixed Dot pulses with lag_ratio 0.2; write ordinal labels 01-05.
Create translucent Prism capsule; Write EVENT-ORDERED and NOT WALL-CLOCK; keep path geometry unchanged.
Create three Torus objects and one Polygon hex cusp; rotate cusp by 60 degrees; draw accepted path and FadeOut rejected branch.
Create receipt_card, world_node, claim_plate and footer; tick receipt; freeze torus and hold final frame for 1 second.

manim_plan.legibility: Use only the listed uppercase labels; no generated pseudo-text, no dense dashboard panels.
manim_plan.object_continuity_check: source_card and evidence_stream exist in every frame; capsule from 8s; torus from 12s; receipt_world_node from 16s.

falsifier.test: Read the authoritative EON/defter source and check whether the remaining-edge counter is actually ordered by wall-clock time or is not written to EON.
falsifier.refuting_observation: A measured source showing wall-clock as the primary ordering surface, or showing the remaining-edge counter outside EON, refutes this visual claim.
falsifier.status: test_required; the film does not supply the measurement
